description: Synthetic chat replay set for #1845: analyst questions over the materialized Miniflux v2.3.3 project, with paraphrase pairs that should share an answer, near-miss pairs that must not, and exact repeats. Asked once before and once after the synthetic patch in patch.json is ingested.
